definitions.ask: Should `@<X>` also follow an unnamed start's drop list, so `=~2@3` works like `=3~2`?

choices.label: `=~2@3` and `==~2@3` start exactly like `=3~2` and `==3~2`; a bare `=@3` stays prose
Only named starts take `@<X>`; `=~2@3` stays an error, now one that teaches `=3~2`

definitions.why: Same cursor-saving win as the named form; the drop-part lexer change is shared anyway.
